Subject: Q2 GTM Launch — readiness check & final OKR alignments

Team —

As we discussed in the exec sync, Q2 go-to-market for the Acme pilot is scheduled to flip on next Monday (2026-05-18). I need a concise readiness snapshot from each function by EOD Friday (5/15) so I can finalize the QBR deck and the launch one-pager for the board. Please respond in-line with: 1) green/amber/red readiness, 2) top 1-2 blockers, 3) owner(s) and ETA to clear.

Attached: Q2-launch-checklist.pdf (master checklist). Also: pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx is in the Drive link below for finance gating.

High-level GTM asks:
- Sales/demo readiness & acceptance criteria (Jonas)
- Enablement assets + public docs (Marcus/Laura)
- Pricing sign-off & procurement path (Rachel)
- Support runbooks + escalation path (Monica)
- Infra/latency SLO confirmation (Aditya)

I’ll compile these into a single slide and circulate to leadership on Saturday. Let me know if you need a quick 15m to align before EOD.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

Eve — quick update from Sales: green/amber.

- Readiness: green for demo pipeline (we have 4 confirmed pilot accounts incl. Acme), amber for deal paperwork — procurement at Acme has a longer legal lead time.
- Blockers: procurement redline around data retention clauses; need Legal/Finance to close DocuSign and SOW by Friday for the pilot kickoff.
- Owners/ETA: Jonas (I) coordinating with Acme (Sarah) and Legal; Rachel to lead pricing/procurement sync. ETA: targeting Fri 5/15 EOD for signatures.

Also: Demo checklist is stable. I’ll drop the demo-recording and test credentials in the shared drive by EOD today.

Eve / team — Engineering update: amber.

- Readiness: Service is holding at expected QPS in staging. We'll run the long-tail latency soak tonight. Endpoint autoscaling rules are tuned; continuous-batching config applied for the demo models.
- Blockers: the docs-referenced prefix-cache invalidation operation is safe but currently requires a restart to clear a stale KV in one rare path. I’ll push a patch to allow safe invalidation without restart by Thursday morning.
- Owners/ETA: Aditya to push hotfix and test in staging. ETA Thu 5/14 07:30 PDT. If that lands, Product/Support can finalize docs and runbook.

Notes: No expected SLA impact for pilot traffic, but we should keep an eye on retry storms.

Thanks,

Thanks for the quick responses — consolidated status and next steps below (I’ll include this slide in the QBR pack). Please confirm completion on assigned ETAs.

Consolidated summary:
- Sales (Jonas): amber — procurement paperwork in flight. Action: coordinate with Rachel + Legal to close SOW/DocuSign. ETA Fri 5/15 EOD.
- Product (Laura): amber -> pending Aditya patch. Action: confirm runbook step and upload final docs. ETA Thu 5/14 EOD.
- Engineering (Aditya): patch planned; please confirm when deployed to staging. ETA Thu 5/14 07:30 PDT.
- Support (Monica): dependent on Product/Eng confirmation to mark green. Action: publish runbook and on-call schedule. ETA Thu 5/14 11:00 PDT.
- Marketing/Enablement (Marcus): blocked on pricing blurb. Action: Rachel to send approved customer-facing pricing text. ETA Fri 5/15 10:00 PDT.

If all ETAs land: Launch readiness = GREEN and I’ll finalize the QBR slide and the board one-pager. If any slip to Friday evening, call with leadership at 7pm Friday to determine a limited scope launch or postpone.
